# Tilmidh

> Word-by-word Quran tajwid trainer. Recite; the microphone checks each Arabic word; the box turns green. Free training tool, not an ijazah.

Site: https://tilmidh.app/
Privacy: https://tilmidh.app/privacy

## Product

Tilmidh (تلميذ, "student") is a mobile-first web app. Text is Uthmani tajweed from Quran.com v4. Speech is the browser Web Speech API (ar-SA), not a cloud LLM. Matching is tolerant on vowels. Duo mode (imam / ṭālib) uses PeerJS with no accounts.

Pedagogical boot: Ikhlāṣ (112), Falaq (113), Nās (114), then Al-Fātiḥah (1). Deep link `/?ref=112:1` loads that verse after boot.

## Do not claim

Not scholar-certified. Not an ijazah. Not a replacement for a muqriʾ. Not Tarteel, not Learn Quran Tajwid, not Quran.com.
